subject.title: Dashboard: chart widgets + widget authoring SDK

question: Should maintainers require the base dashboard stack to land and this branch to rebase before review continues, or authorize this exact cumulative dependency/security-boundary head?
rationale: The chart delta is useful, but this head also carries dependency graph changes, a conflicting stacked base, and widget-host security surfaces that automation cannot safely approve as incidental churn.

options.title: Land base stack then rebase
options.body: Require the lower dashboard PRs to land first, then rebase this PR so review focuses on chart widgets, authoring docs, and examples.

options.title: Authorize exact head
options.body: A maintainer/security owner can intentionally accept the dependency graph and cumulative widget-host security surface for this exact head SHA before continuing review.

options.title: Pause dashboard expansion
options.body: Pause or close the branch if maintainers decide the dashboard roadmap should not expand in core right now.

recommendation.title: Land base stack then rebase
recommendation.body: Require the lower dashboard PRs to land first, then rebase this PR so review focuses on chart widgets, authoring docs, and examples.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the clearest recent current-main owner signal for adjacent Control UI shell and plugin infrastructure touched by the cumulative stack.
